2. Rostov Academic Drama Theatre: This theatre is one of the oldest and most prestigious cultural institutions in Rostov, and it features performances of classic and contemporary plays.

3. Rostov State Musical Theatre: This theatre is dedicated to opera and ballet, and it has a rich repertoire of both classical and modern productions.

4. Rostov State Museum of Fine Arts: This museum houses a collection of Russian art from the 18th to 20th centuries, including works by famous artists such as Ilya Repin, Ivan Shishkin, and Marc Chagall.

- Media habits (July 2023): The Economist on commute, NYT Sundays, The Daily podcast during workouts.
- 2023/07/21: received book recs (Klein, Kolbert, Wallace-Wells, Robinson, Rich, Goodell, Taylor), engagement ideas (podcasts, ProPublica, Politico, clubs, volunteering), org lists (EDF, Sierra Club, Grist, 350.org, Earthjustice, UCS, Climate Nexus), plus climate-focused resources (Climate Central, InsideClimate News, Carbon Brief, NRDC, CAN).
- 2023/07/28: planned Rostov-on-Don trip for end of May (mild weather, Rostov Don Festival); interested in museums, theaters, Gorky Park, Don River boat tour, skyline viewpoints, traditional cuisine; asked about transit, timing, best-view spots.
- 2023/08/05: asked how African countries protect wildlife from poaching/illegal hunting — possible emerging wildlife-conservation interest.
- Open to future book/resource/activity recommendations; appreciative tone throughout.
